title: Why known counterparties still pay a middle layer
purpose: Invert the Scan 018 bypass question. Identify markets where buyer and supplier already know each other yet repeatedly continue paying an intermediary. Persistent payment after direct contact is evidence of durable control-plane value. Then test whether a smaller Xuzhou/Jiangsu analogue remains informally handled and not already productized.
scan_rule: A MIDDLE LAYER SURVIVES DIRECT CONTACT ONLY IF IT CONTINUES TO OWN RESPONSIBILITY
NON_BYPASSABLE_VALUE CAN COME FROM ACCEPTANCE, LIABILITY, REPLACEMENT, ESCROW, FINANCING, COMPLIANCE, AGGREGATION, SETTLEMENT OR GEOGRAPHIC COVERAGE
DURABLE CONTROL_PLANE FUNCTION != OPEN ROOTER OPPORTUNITY when the function is already maturely productized or requires regulated/asset-heavy responsibility

evidence: QIMA sells independent factory-floor inspections even when buyer and supplier already have a direct commercial relationship.
The recurring value is independent sampling, documented pass/fail evidence, same-day reporting and geographic coverage rather than introduction.
durable_middle_layer_functions.why_counterparties_keep_paying: The supplier cannot credibly self-issue the buyer's independent acceptance evidence.
xuzhou_analogue_recheck: Xuzhou already procures third-party acceptance for SME digital-transformation projects, with the provider responsible for independent process tracking and final acceptance.
Manufacturing/product inspection and testing already have mature TIC/third-party routes.

evidence: Buyer and supplier can know and negotiate with each other directly, but the platform still holds payment, records order terms, mediates disputes and provides refund/compensation mechanisms.
Protection applies only when the transaction remains inside the platform.
durable_middle_layer_functions.why_counterparties_keep_paying: The platform owns enforceable transaction evidence, payment control and dispute mechanics that neither counterparty can provide neutrally.

durable_middle_layer_functions.function: inventory aggregation / availability / replenishment / consumption settlement
evidence: Supplier and factory already know each other, yet the recurring control plane remains valuable because someone must maintain stock, monitor consumption, replenish before stockout and settle based on actual usage.
Current Jiangsu VMI solutions already automate low-stock alerts, replenishment triggers, line-side issue records and consumption-based settlement.
durable_middle_layer_functions.why_counterparties_keep_paying: The recurring value is continuous availability and inventory responsibility, not matching.
xuzhou_analogue_recheck: Engineering-machinery and industrial-parts suppliers in Xuzhou already hold large local parts inventories and provide direct repair/supply support.
Generic multi-supplier VMI would face mature MRO/VMI software, distributor and smart-cabinet incumbents.

durable_middle_layer_functions.function: legal carrier responsibility / qualification / settlement / dispute
evidence: 2026 rules define network-freight platforms as contracting carriers that integrate transport resources while bearing carrier responsibility.
Platforms must verify vehicle/driver qualifications, settle freight, preserve transaction/trajectory records, operate complaint/dispute mechanisms and may use carrier-liability insurance.
durable_middle_layer_functions.why_counterparties_keep_paying: The platform is not merely a lead source; it becomes the accountable carrier and compliance/settlement layer.

durable_middle_layer_functions.function: labor compliance / insurance / payroll / tax settlement
evidence: Current platforms digitize task publication, worker verification, payroll/settlement, employer insurance, claims and tax-compliance records.
The employer may already know the worker, but the compliant transaction wrapper remains valuable.
durable_middle_layer_functions.why_counterparties_keep_paying: The middle layer carries regulatory, insurance, payroll and evidence obligations.

evidence: Current engineering-equipment platforms combine demand matching with equipment condition management, fulfillment tracking, insurance/financial services and after-sales support.
XCMG aggregates specialist insurers for long-term engineering-machinery coverage and claims support.
PICC Xuzhou procures third-party lifting-equipment condition reports and site inspections as recurring insurance-risk services.
durable_middle_layer_functions.why_counterparties_keep_paying: Risk evidence, insurance and fulfillment responsibility persist after the owner/renter or insurer/insured know each other.

durable_middle_layer_functions.function: agricultural dispatch + acceptance + evidence + insurance ecosystem
evidence: Xuzhou-based 马力多 already matches farmers and operators, authenticates machinery, supports orders and builds insurance/parts/finance ecosystem functions.
Agricultural social-service programs increasingly use contracts, operation trajectories, platform verification, acceptance and third-party checking.
durable_middle_layer_functions.why_counterparties_keep_paying: The durable function is verified service execution, dispatch and evidence, not one-time contact.

cross_industry_result.durable_value_definition: A middle layer remains paid after counterparties know each other when it continuously owns responsibility neither side can cheaply self-provide: independent acceptance, escrow/dispute enforcement, availability/replenishment, regulated liability, insurance, compliance, settlement, aggregation or geographic coverage.
material_learning: The Rooter business must own recurring responsibility, not introductions.
The strongest non-bypassable functions are often exactly the functions that become vertical platforms, regulated intermediaries, insurers, TIC providers, distributors or VMI operators.
A smaller market is attractive only if the responsibility function already exists informally and counterparties repeatedly pay for it, yet no incumbent has productized it.
If Rooter must assume regulated carrier, insurer, employer, prime-contractor or asset-inventory liability to retain value, the route likely violates current low-permission/low-capital constraints.
cross_industry_result.current_best_next_truth: Fresh Scan 020 should search Xuzhou/Jiangsu for recurring paid human coordinators who remain in the loop after counterparties know each other because they personally guarantee replacement, acceptance, settlement or availability. The target is not a formal platform; it is a small private market where an individual/agent is already paid repeatedly for a responsibility function that could be standardized and delegated without regulated principal liability.
